description: Provides a high-level typed API layer on top of HoloNET Client for building Holochain hApp integrations in .NET. Part of the NextGen World / OASIS Omniverse ecosystem. https://oasisomniverse.one
releaseNotes:
## v4.5.1 - HoloNETAPI.Configure(holoNETDNA) and HoloNETAPI.UseConductor(adminUri, logToConsole): set the conductor and logging the API uses in one line.

## v4.5.0 - Per-key storage (one entry per key; single-entry stores migrate automatically), shared data (SaveSharedDataAsync / LoadSharedDataAsync / ...), change notifications (SubscribeToChangesAsync + OnDataChanged), SendSignalToAllAsync, typed loads/saves (LoadDataAsync<int>, SaveDataAsync(key, 42)), ListKeysAsync / ExistsAsync, and sync versions of every common call.

## v4.4.2 - One-line deletes (DeleteDataAsync, DeleteObjectAsync, DeleteAllDataAsync, DeleteAllObjectsAsync), safe straight after a restart; the API remembers the hApp it was initialised with, so one-line calls keep using it after ShutdownAsync / restarts.

## v4.4.1 - The bundled oasis.happ now has the HyperNET zome functions, so SendSignalAsync works with the default hApp (the previous bundled build predated them).

## v4.4.0 - Direct messages: SendSignalAsync + OnSignalReceived (remote signals, peer to peer); ReceiveSignal returns the last message (SendSignal/ReceiveSignal were placeholders); XML docs for every member.

## v4.2.0 - first release on NuGet; works against the Holochain 0.7 OASIS hApp (0.7.0 and 0.7.1)

- Simple key/value + object store: SaveDataAsync/LoadDataAsync, SaveObjectAsync/LoadObjectAsync<T>, one hApp entry per StoreId, created then updated by action hash.
- Reuses the installed app (data survives restarts); errors reported through OnError, LastError and each result's Message; ShutdownAsync.
- New HoloNETAPIHapp overloads; the old (hAppId, hAppPath, hAppRole) string overloads are obsolete because they could bind to the zome/function overloads.
- Fully tested against real Holochain 0.7.0 and 0.7.1 conductors (1,758 + 9 live/fake-conductor tests on each), line coverage ~93%.
- Requires NextGenSoftware.Logging / NextGenSoftware.WebSocket 2.0.4 (fixes below).

Full changelog: https://github.com/holochain-open-dev/holochain-client-csharp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

---

Initial public release of HoloNET API.
